subject: design/argus-journal-type-recovery
statement: Positive Argus precedence, protected-path refusal, positive human attestation and underivable fail-closed behavior remain in force. No correction creates an operator attestation, action-class grant, lock approval, accepted plan or application acceptance. Planning still requires the actual binding lock and native precheck; first-proposal scope still excludes numbered plans. Configured roots relocate the same fixed grammars.
